ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Minnesota's Healthcare System
ideas.description: This story could investigate the effects of a recent $3.5 million Medicaid fraud scheme on Minnesota's healthcare system.
ideas.angle: The human impact of Medicaid fraud
questions: What steps are being taken to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the issue of Medicaid fraud and its consequences for the healthcare system.

ideas.title: The Legitimacy of the FBI's Election Investigation
ideas.description: This story could examine the FBI's investigation into Fulton County vote records and the use of previously investigated 2020 election claims.
questions: What are the implications for future investigations?
ideas.insight: This story could raise important questions about the legitimacy of the investigation and the potential for politicization.
